title: INDEX — Atlas mondial des ordres et registres d'architectes
description: Sourced and dated headcounts of architects' official registration bodies (orders, chambers, boards, councils) for 180 countries, with registration regime, title protection, public registers, open-data catalogue and A–D data-quality grades. Every figure carries its primary source URL. Not a directory of persons: name lists stay with their publishers, linked, never copied. Site and canonical dataset: https://index.archi — atlas.json at https://index.archi/atlas.json
